definitions.nullPolicy: Exclude missing values from numeric calculations; retain valid and missing counts.
definitions.transferCount: Maximum of nTransferred, nBlindTransferred, nConsultTransferred sums, following supplied reference; components retained separately.
definitions.mos: MinMos prefers conversation summary, falls back to endpoint minimum; EndpointMinMos uses mediaEndpointStats.minMos only.
definitions.agentMetrics: Agent-work metrics are summed only from agent/user participants; seconds fields convert milliseconds.
definitions.errors: One event per segment with a non-empty errorCode. Conversation membership is deduplicated per code; occurrences are not.

entityResolution.definition: Current entity labels at collection time; IDs remain authoritative. Missing names retain the ID. Names are not historical identity evidence.
